rationale: Right-clicking a CSS drag region in a hidden-titlebar window causes a native null-pointer crash. draggable-regions identifies the trigger; BrowserWindow is an acceptable integration label. The complete main.js, package.json and run/right-click steps are runnable, so do not ask for a gist. nodeIntegration/contextIsolation are setup flags; Chromium frames alone do not establish an upstream bug. The matching report #51576 was opened later and is ineligible at this cutoff.
